_comment: Drip earned (DESIGN.md §6.7, Cosmetics), checked by SkinTable.problems(). extract: getting out of a PMC raid or a Scav run (not a Run Through, not practice) pays base plus the highest loot bracket whose value the loot brought out reaches (base value in roubles of what you picked up). kills: per kill by who it was (scav, guard, pmc, boss), in PMC raids and Scav runs, whatever the outcome. quest: per quest completed, on top of its own Drip reward. level: per level gained. Daily and weekly tasks pay their kind's "drip" in data/tasks/operations.json; 360 trick-shot kills pay raid.tres drip_trick_kill.
